def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    measurements = [-3, -11, 3, -18, 18, 20, -6, 9, 2, -16]
    
    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    mean = sum(measurements) / len(measurements)
    variance = sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in measurements) / (len(measurements) - 1)
    answer = round(variance ** 0.5, 3)
    
    # return answer
    return answer
